text: 很正常，有可能越普通的男人越在乎老婆的功能性，包括生孩子、做家务、照顾自己、照顾他家人。
en: Perfectly normal. It is possible that the more ordinary the man, the more he cares about his wife's functionality, including bearing children, doing housework, looking after himself, and looking after his family.

text: 40岁的女人如果没生育过，那么生育功能基本丧失，要生也得花大价钱去做试管，思维正常的人都会想：有这闲钱干啥不好？
en: If a 40-year-old woman has never given birth, then her reproductive function is essentially lost; if she wants a child she would have to spend a fortune on IVF, and any sane person would think: why not do something better with that spare money?

text: 40岁的女人如果没结过婚，有可能都比较独立，不愿依靠男人，自然也不愿意被男人依靠。
en: If a 40-year-old woman has never married, she is likely fairly independent, unwilling to rely on a man, and naturally unwilling to be depended on by one either.

text: 什么照顾你吃喝拉撒？
en: What, look after your eating, drinking, shitting and pissing?

text: 你又不瘫，我又不欠你，凭什么？
en: You are not paralysed, and I do not owe you anything, so on what grounds?

text: 40岁的女人能独自生活，那经济能力肯定能负担得起养活自己，为什么要看别人脸色呢？
en: If a 40-year-old woman can live on her own, then her financial capacity must be enough to support herself, so why should she live at the mercy of others' moods?

text: 她们很可能忍不了男人臭脾气和坏习惯。
en: They are quite likely unable to tolerate men's foul tempers and bad habits.

text: 所以可以看出，40岁的女人在大部分普通男人眼里毫无价值。
en: So one can see that, in the eyes of most ordinary men, a 40-year-old woman is utterly worthless.

text: 只有不在意女性功能性的男人，才会不在意女性年龄大，不过他们依然选择了比自己小二十岁以上的老女人。
en: Only men who do not care about a woman's functionality will not mind an older woman, yet even they still choose older women more than twenty years their junior.

text: 比如下面这几位：
en: For example, the following few:

text: 贝索斯的未婚妻51岁。
en: Bezos's fiancée is 51.

text: 抛弃50多岁邓文迪的默多克，新老婆60多。
en: Murdoch, who cast aside the 50-something Wendi Deng, has a new wife in her 60s.

text: 巩俐也是50多跟这个法国人。
en: Gong Li, also in her 50s, is with this French man.

text: 中国人多少还是喜欢年轻的肉体，可能因为中国女人40岁以后很少有手感好的。
en: Chinese people still rather like young bodies, perhaps because few Chinese women over forty have a pleasant feel to them.

text: 比如这几位名人都选择了30岁左右的：
en: For instance, these celebrities all chose women around 30:

text: 都认识我就不写名字了。
en: You all know them, so I will not write the names.

text: 我同意另一位答主的意见，40岁的女人没必要纠结结婚不结婚，要学会放下情情爱爱，现实一点、功利一点，让自己过得开心一点。
en: I agree with another answerer: a 40-year-old woman need not agonise over whether to marry or not; she should learn to let go of romantic love, be more realistic and more pragmatic, and make herself a bit happier.

text: 毕竟人生除了婚姻，还有很多值得追求的目标，让自己活出更多的可能性，也不失为一个可以为之努力终身的目标。
en: After all, besides marriage, life has many goals worth pursuing; living out more of one's possibilities is itself a goal worth striving for throughout one's life.

text: 就像我们上学的时候老师教的考试策略，试卷里有十个大题，你卡在了第三个题目里，那么时间到了，你会不及格。
en: It is like the exam strategy our teacher taught us at school: if the paper has ten big questions and you get stuck on the third, then when time is up you will fail.

text: 如果你发现第三个题目你做不出，最佳策略是先放下这题做后面的，就算最后没做出，好歹也能及格，万一运气好后面的题让你顿悟，你说不定还能把第三题解出来。
en: If you find you cannot do the third question, the best strategy is to put it aside first and do the later ones; even if you never solve it, at least you will pass, and if you are lucky the later questions might give you a sudden insight, and you might even solve the third.

text: 你去看历史上，很多伟大的女性，都是选择独身的，说不定她们的成功也与她们独身有关系。
en: Look through history and you will find many great women chose to remain single; perhaps their success was connected to their being single.

text: 因为独身了，就没人能阻止她做自己想做的事情，不是吗？
en: Because once single, no one can stop her from doing what she wants, can they?

text: 列几位中国的优秀独身女性：
en: Let me list a few outstanding single Chinese women:

text: 与蔡元培齐名的教育家吴贻芳。
en: The educator Yifang Wu, who was as renowned as Yuanpei Cai.

text: 白衣天使林巧稚说她接生的每个婴儿都是自己的孩子。
en: The angel in white, Qiaozhi Lin, said every baby she delivered was her own child.

text: 国务院副总理吴仪女士。
en: Madam Yi Wu, Vice Premier of the State Council.

text: 婚姻市场上，大家互相考评价值很正常，但不要因为别人没有看到他需要的价值，你自己就否定自己的价值。
en: In the marriage market, it is perfectly normal for people to assess each other's value, but do not deny your own worth just because someone else fails to see the value they need.

text: 人，这辈子最重要的是为自己而活，活成自己想要的样子。
en: As a human being, the most important thing in this life is to live for oneself and become the person one wants to be.

text: 关注我 @培训师金刚狼小姐 ，人生不迷路。
en: Follow me @Trainer Miss Wolverine, and you will not lose your way in life.

text: 读过的书、走过的路、遇见的人，愿与你分享。
en: The books I have read, the roads I have travelled, the people I have met — I wish to share them with you.

text: 我是金刚狼小姐，祝你幸福。
en: I am Miss Wolverine, and I wish you happiness.

text: 作为相亲平台发现不但优质，和一般普通40岁的男人，他绝对不可能去考虑，为自己找一个40岁女人的，从一般情况来说，他会找比他年龄起码小3一5岁甚至年龄相差较多的女生，因为男人总喜欢，找年纪比较轻靓丽的女生，做自己的女朋友，这种行为举止很正常。
en: As a matchmaking platform, we have found that not only the high-quality men, but even ordinary 40-year-old men, would absolutely never consider finding themselves a 40-year-old woman. Generally speaking, he will look for a girl at least 3 to 5 years younger than him, or even one with a much larger age gap, because men always like to find a relatively young and beautiful girl to be their girlfriend; such behaviour is perfectly normal.

text: 说句实在话，40岁的男人正当中年刚开始，年富力强事业有成，不是有私企老板，就是建设新时代公司老总，和技术力量的干骨，社会阅历丰富干炼成熟，魅力十足对年轻女生吸引力很强…
en: To be honest, a 40-year-old man is just entering his prime middle years, vigorous and successful in his career; he is either the boss of a private firm, or the head of a company building the new era, or a backbone of technical expertise — rich in social experience, capable and mature, full of charm and highly attractive to young women…

text: ，所以他们一般找对象，不可能找同龄女人，不知大家怎么看不当请指教。
en: , so generally, when looking for a partner, they would never choose a woman their own age; I do not know what you all think — please correct me if I am wrong.

text: 有钱的话为什么不找年轻一点的？
en: If you have money, why not find someone younger?

text: 40岁的女人既没有生育价值也没年轻姑凉水嫩了
en: A 40-year-old woman has neither reproductive value nor the youthful, dewy freshness of a young girl.

text: 至于没钱的
en: As for those without money,

text: 没钱男早就妥协了
en: Men without money compromised long ago.

text: 那点工资吃点好的，洗洗脚不是更舒服
en: With that bit of salary, would it not be more comfortable to eat something nice and get a foot massage?

text: 找个更年期的来管自己是嫌本就苦难的生活过得太轻松吗
en: Bringing home a menopausal woman to boss you around — do you find your already hard life too easy?

text: 能问出这问题的、和在意这个问题里的表述内容的这群人，都是把自己和对象物化最彻底的一群人。
en: The people who can ask this question, and those who care about the wording in it, are the ones who objectify themselves and their partners most thoroughly.

text: 在这群人眼里、脑子里，根本就是把女性当个物品来看的。
en: In the eyes and minds of this group, women are simply regarded as objects.

text: 因为女性一过40岁，她的外貌和生育等物品属性显著下降，这群寻找物品买卖、或者找传宗接代合作者、或者找性欲发泄者的人，他们眼里这样的女性就“不值钱”了。
en: Because once a woman passes 40, her appearance and reproductive capacity, as item attributes, decline markedly; in the eyes of those seeking to buy and sell objects, or looking for a partner to carry on the family line, or seeking an outlet for sexual desire, such a woman becomes 'worthless'.

text: 问题是，我们是人啊，不是牛，不是羊，不是狗，不是猪，不是家禽，不是牲口，不是动物，我们是人啊！
en: The problem is, we are human beings, not cattle, not sheep, not dogs, not pigs, not poultry, not beasts of burden, not animals — we are human beings!

text: 我们自诩万物之灵，我们长着脑子，我们上那么多年的学，我们读那么多的书，我们学习数学，我们了解星空，我们通过文字记录文明，我们学习这一切，就因为我们不仅仅是个物品，我们不仅仅是别人的性交对象，我们是个有情有爱、有心有脑的人啊！
en: We pride ourselves as the spirit of all things; we have brains, we spent so many years in school, we read so many books, we study mathematics, we understand the starry sky, we record civilisation through writing; we learn all this precisely because we are not merely objects, not merely someone else's sexual partner — we are human beings with feelings and love, with hearts and minds!

text: 我的建议是鱼找鱼虾找虾，乌龟找王八，物以类聚，人以群分。
en: My advice is: fish find fish and shrimp find shrimp, turtles find tortoises — like attracts like, and people divide into their own groups.

text: 你们找性交对象找性欲发泄者的这群生殖器主宰者，你们就找个经营皮肉生意者结合就挺好。
en: You who seek sexual partners and outlets for lust, you genital-dominated creatures, you would do well to join with those who ply the flesh trade.

text: 没必要还披着人皮，人模人样的出来找对象，你们的对象也跟你们一样，是一群被生殖器主宰着的人形物种。
en: There is no need to put on human skin and parade about in human form looking for a partner; your partners are just like you, a species of human-shaped beings dominated by their genitals.

text: 正常人类，他们就正常的生活着，依照自己的内心，过自己的人生，遇到一个内心有共鸣、心意相通的伴侣，自然结合，陪伴余生。
en: Normal human beings simply live normal lives, following their own hearts, living their own lives; when they meet a partner whose heart resonates with theirs and whose mind is in harmony, they come together naturally and keep each other company for the rest of their days.

text: 遇不到那个宿命伴侣，自己照常生活就好。
en: If you never meet that destined partner, just live your life as usual.

text: 因为数学告诉我，年轻女性更有优势
en: Because mathematics tells me that younger women have the advantage.

text: 我这个人很现实
en: I am a very practical person.

text: 我觉得做任何事情都要看成本和收益的
en: I think in anything one does, one must weigh the costs and the benefits.

text: 20.30.40女的利弊，我们来分析一下
en: The pros and cons of women aged 20, 30 and 40 — let us analyse them.

text: 1.匹配对象的可能性
en: 1. The likelihood of finding a match.

text: 这么说吧，房子车子彩礼跟女方的年龄无关，跟女方的情况、需求与认知有关
en: To put it this way: the house, the car and the bride price have nothing to do with the woman's age, and everything to do with her circumstances, needs and outlook.

text: 很多女的，她们20岁要彩礼，30岁要彩礼，40岁还是要彩礼，哪怕40岁离婚带娃依然要彩礼
en: Many women demand a bride price at 20, demand one at 30, and still demand one at 40; even a 40-year-old divorcee with a child still demands a bride price.

text: 哪怕她自己有房子有车子，也要男的有房子有车子和彩礼
en: Even if she herself owns a house and a car, she still requires the man to have a house, a car and a bride price.

text: 有一种错误认知，我要纠正一下
en: There is a mistaken belief I would like to correct.

text: 那就是年轻女孩见识少、要求低、更容易满足
en: Namely, that young girls have seen little, have low expectations and are easier to satisfy.

text: 其实并不是
en: In fact, that is not the case.

text: 而是要求低的女人更容易结婚，她们就不会再出现在婚恋市场上，而那些要求高的女人就会继续流转下去
en: Rather, women with low expectations marry more easily and thus no longer appear on the marriage market, while those with high expectations keep circulating.

text: 做个小模型吧
en: Let us build a small model.

text: 比如有100个20岁的姑娘，各方面都一样，只是对配偶的要求不一样，其中30个要求低，40个要求中，30个要求高，要求高的占比是30%
en: Suppose there are 100 twenty-year-old girls, identical in every respect except their demands of a spouse: 30 have low demands, 40 have moderate demands, and 30 have high demands, so the high-demand proportion is 30%.

text: 过了10年，30个要求低的基本上结婚了，40个要求中的有10个结婚了，30个要求高的都没结婚，要求高的占比是50%
en: Ten years on, the 30 with low demands have essentially all married, 10 of the 40 with moderate demands have married, and none of the 30 with high demands have married, so the high-demand proportion is now 50%.

text: 再过了10年，要求中的还有5个未婚，要求高的有5个已婚，那么要求高的占比就是83%
en: Another ten years later, 5 of the moderate-demand group remain unmarried and 5 of the high-demand group have married, so the high-demand proportion becomes 83%.

text: 所以就会给人一种感觉，怎么年龄越大要求高的越多，其实她们只是被剩下来而已
en: So one gets the impression that the older they are, the more high-demand women there are, when in fact they have merely been left over.

text: 那么在其他条件都差不多的情况下，任何男人的优先选择肯定是要求低的女人
en: So, all else being equal, any man's first choice will naturally be a woman with low demands.

text: 而越年轻的女人中，要求低的占比越多
en: And among younger women, the share with low demands is greater.

text: 在其他条件差不多的情况下，为什么要选择一个要求高的?
en: With other conditions being similar, why choose someone with high demands?

text: 同样的模型也适用于，找个人品好的，找个性格好的，找个贤惠的
en: The same model also applies to finding someone of good character, a good temperament, or a virtuous and capable homemaker.

text: 一般情况下，20岁人品好、性格好、贤惠的女人，40岁也一样，20岁人品差、性格差、好吃懒做的女人，40岁也一样
en: Generally, a woman who is of good character, good temperament and virtuous at 20 will be the same at 40; a woman who is of bad character, bad temperament, and lazy and gluttonous at 20 will be the same at 40.

text: 我相信20岁人品好、性格好、贤惠女人的比例，应该跟30岁甚至40岁人品好、性格好、贤惠女人的比例差不多
en: I believe the proportion of women of good character, good temperament and virtue at 20 should be about the same as that at 30 or even 40.

text: 所以，20岁人品好、性格好、贤惠单身女人的比例，要远远大于，40岁人品好、性格好、贤惠单身女人比例
en: Therefore, the proportion of single women of good character, good temperament and virtue at 20 is far greater than the proportion of such single women at 40.

text: 对于大多数男人来说，肯定希望找个人品好、性格好、贤惠的女人
en: For most men, one certainly hopes to find a woman of good character, good temperament and virtue.

text: 数字模型告诉我们，越年轻的女性，匹配度高的占比就越多
en: The numerical model tells us that the younger the woman, the greater the share of those with a high match.

text: 2.投入成本
en: 2. Input costs.

text: 依然是其他不变的情况下
en: Still assuming other factors remain unchanged.

text: （1）生育成本
en: (1) The cost of childbearing.

text: 20.30.40女人生育的成本，是越来越高的
en: The cost of childbearing for women aged 20, 30 and 40 is increasingly high.

text: 我说的不仅是男方成本，还有女方成本
en: I am referring not only to the man's costs, but also to the woman's.

text: 除非一开始就准备丁克，或者去找非法DY
en: Unless one plans to be child-free (DINK) from the start, or goes looking for illegal surrogacy (DY).

text: 东南亚是5到15（非法），中国是10到20（非法），乌克兰是20到30（合法），美国是45万起（合法）
en: Southeast Asia is 5 to 15 (illegal), China is 10 to 20 (illegal), Ukraine is 20 to 30 (legal), and the United States starts at 450,000 (legal).

text: （2）想法观念
en: (2) Mindset and values.

text: 20.30.40女人的收入的确是逐步上升的
en: The income of women aged 20, 30 and 40 does rise gradually.

text: 但是，对应的消费也是逐步上升的
en: But their corresponding consumption also rises gradually.

text: 她每月收入几千的时候，消费观念不会几万的
en: When she earns a few thousand a month, her spending habits will not be at the tens-of-thousands level.

text: 当她收入几万的时候，消费观念也绝对不是几千的
en: When her income reaches tens of thousands, her spending habits certainly will not be at the few-thousands level.

text: 但问题是，这个对于你对于家庭来说，其实并没有任何太多好处
en: But the problem is, this actually brings you or the family no real benefit to speak of.

text: 因为中国当代女性，很多都是赚多少花多少，甚至还有缺口，很多往往收入越高，缺口就越大
en: Because many contemporary Chinese women spend whatever they earn, and even run a deficit; often the higher the income, the larger the deficit.

text: 市场好的时候，其实影响还不大，如果遇到经济下行的时候，比如当下，那应该怎么办呢？
en: When the market is good the impact is not great, but if one meets an economic downturn, as at present, then what should be done?

text: 还是那句话，年龄越小的消费相对会小，而她们年龄大了之后，因为有孩子，她们的观念很多会改变的
en: As the saying goes, the younger the age, the relatively smaller the consumption; and once they grow older, having children, many of their outlooks will change.

text: 往往消费最可怕的就是那些大龄单身女
en: Often the most frightening consumers are those older single women.

text: 你有多少身价能往里面贴的?
en: How much of a fortune do you have to pour into that?

text: 我如果还是单身的话，我肯定会在20多岁里面选择，实在不行会去30多岁里面找，40岁肯定是不考虑
en: If I were still single, I would certainly choose from those in their twenties; if all else failed I would look among those in their thirties; at forty I definitely would not consider it.
